title: 1938 Sichuan Army folded single-blanket pack

actualBundleDimensionsM.includes: continuous folded sheet, conforming repair patch and cotton stitches

parts.description: One continuous folded homespun cotton sheet with exposed nested cut edges, a conforming sewn repair patch and a planar contact leaf
A connected long grey cloth strip makes two horizontal and two vertical outward passes, two shoulder loops and a small side knot; no metal fittings
Exactly two open woven-straw shoes, traditional tied uppers and one thin suspension cord per shoe
Horizontal rolled woven-straw sleeping mat with rolled end edges; its two top fastening loops hide with the mat
Complete civilian indigo short jacket inside the blanket fold; only one corner and one cloth knot button show at rest
